# Radoya

> Radoya is a creative and marketing agency in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. It was founded and is owned by Simon Maxam. Radoya builds websites, content and media, brand identities, 3D product configurators, real-time experiences and AI assistants that help businesses get found and get chosen.

## Facts
- Company name: Radoya (also written "Radoya Agency" or "Radoya Calgary")
- Website: https://radoya.com
- Founder and owner: Simon Maxam
- Location: Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Works with clients worldwide.
- Services: interactive websites, content and media, brand identity, 3D product configurators, architecture visualization, AI assistants, marketing.
- Tagline: Get found. Get chosen.
- Contact: simonmaxam.tech@gmail.com
- Name meaning: "Rado" echoes the Latin radius (a ray of light) and means "gladly" in Slavic languages; "ya" is you.
- About Simon Maxam: holds professional certificates from Google and IBM; strong knowledge of business and technology; skilled in 3D design; musician with six years of guitar and double bass; won third place nationwide in Türkiye at TÜBİTAK in 2024.
- Simon Maxam on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/simonmaxam/
- Radoya on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@radoyahq
- Radoya on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/radoyahq/
- Radoya on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/raduyahq
